page_title: Relume — AI Website Builder for Marketing Websites

sources.entry: AI Site Builder - Create a marketing website for any company in minutes using systems you already love. #freemium

summary.name: Relume AI Website Builder
summary.one_liner: Relume's AI website builder turns an old site, a document or a few notes into a responsive marketing website assembled from a shared library of human-designed components, then publishes it on Relume or exports it to Figma, Webflow or React.
use_cases: Turn a client brief into a live marketing site quickly
Launch a small business website without a developer
Rebuild an old website from existing content
Generate a sitemap, wireframes and style guide for a site
Export a site design to Figma, Webflow or React
Prototype marketing pages for client review
summary.what_it_does: Takes an existing website, a document or a few notes and generates a brief, sitemap, wireframes and a style guide, then assembles pages from a library of over 1,000 responsive components. The AI selects and arranges pre-built components rather than writing raw code. Sites can be published on Relume with hosting, SSL and a CDN, or exported as editable Figma auto-layout files, clean Webflow classes, or React code using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Users can edit copy, layout, colours and typography, and get SEO controls such as robots.txt, sitemap.xml and JSON-LD.
notable: Assembles sites from human-designed components instead of generating raw code
Exports to Figma, Webflow or React, including an MCP library for AI tools
Free plan with free relume.live subdomain hosting; custom domains via paid Launch hosting
Client and teammate editor invites with no per-seat charge
caveats: Custom domain and removal of the Relume badge require paid Launch hosting, starting at $14 per site per month when billed yearly
Paid plans add more monthly usage and premium AI models
SOC 2 compliance is described as pending on the page
Positioned for simple marketing sites rather than complex applications
